description: Wolfeboro NH restaurant directory for wolfeboroevents.com. Weekly hours recheck: edit this file only, update hours_checked, hours_confidence and last_checked.
hours_format: hours.<day> is a list of [open, close] 24-hour pairs in local time. [] means closed that day. null means not confirmed (show 'Hours not confirmed, call ahead').

restaurants.name: Wolfe's Tavern at the Wolfeboro Inn
restaurants.hours_text: Breakfast 7:30 to 10 a.m. Thu to Mon. Lunch and dinner Wed to Sun from 10:30 a.m. Closed Tuesday.
restaurants.hours_note: Kitchen closes an hour before the bar (Wed and Thu kitchen until 8, bar until 9; Fri and Sat kitchen until 9, bar until 10). Sunday closes at 7.
restaurants.confidence_note: Official page and Google agree. The Chamber listing still has an April 2025 note about a renovation; ignore it.
